test_title: PYST 29: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - GA (Held On: 21 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: What was the Supreme Court's directive regarding the NEET-PG 2025 examination format?

options.text: Conduct the exam in a single shift
Conduct the exam in two shifts

solution:
The correct answer is __**Conduct the exam in a single shift**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Supreme Court of India** directed that the **NEET-PG 2025 examination** should be conducted in a **single shift** to ensure uniformity and fairness in the evaluation process.
 
• This decision was made to address discrepancies and prevent any unfair advantage that might arise due to different difficulty levels in multiple shifts. **Uniformity** in examination standards is critical for a competitive test like NEET-PG.
 
• The court emphasized that conducting the examination in a single shift would ensure a **level playing field** for all candidates
